notes.title: [DEMO] Fixes and lights
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]More and more of you are playing our demo, thank you! However, several crashes have been reported, so it was time to fix them![/p][p]Here comes version [b]0.1.22[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a critical freeze after the first cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various non-blocking crashes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a button to skip certain cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved night lighting for all buildings — whether you're neutral, good, or evil[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ll keep checking every crash that gets reported and squash them as fast as possible, so expect a few small updates this week![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the game 🫰[/p]

notes.title: First trailer and demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !

Here’s our very first post to announce our very first trailer ! It gives a little bit of context about the game’s story, and most importantly, shows some gameplay footage.
We’re currently working on the next trailer to showcase the rest of the game and a few surprises we’re keeping secret for now.

One more small announcement we can share: [b]the demo is almost ready and should be available by the end of April ![/b]

We can’t wait to share all of this with you and to see your cities once the demo is out !

See you soon 🫰
